{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVMdNDs8AAAABZhSB7A", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BnXy5zhDISCs", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BnXy5", "number": 41, "title": "Preserve PMX vertex-group morphs through glTF, VMD playback and Demo", "body": "## Problem

PMX group expressions disappear during conversion. `tools/pmx-morph.ts` skips type-0 payloads, `packages/mmd-morph` requires their targets to be null, and VMD binding treats them as unsupported. Existing synthetic fixtures already contain a group referencing vertex morph 1 at rate 0.5. Consequently, expressions composed entirely of supported vertex offsets cannot survive conversion, playback or manual Demo controls.

## Expected outcome

Support one-hop groups whose children are exclusively vertex morphs. Compile each supported group into an independent core POSITION target, preserving source identity and every referenced morph index/rate in model metadata. Reuse core weight animation and the existing VMD extension, reusable APIs, exporter paths and Demo.

For this bounded profile, define `groupDelta = sum(rate × childDelta)` and apply direct and group targets additively before skinning. Do not also redistribute group weights into child targets. Example: child weight 0.3 plus group weight 0.8 referencing that child at rate 0.5 produces 0.7 times the child delta, while stored control weights remain 0.3 and 0.8. Document duplicate-entry summation and signed composition as project policies whose original-MMD equivalence remains unmeasured.

## Context

Baseline: `0e92395a8977996c5daa89cd284e0a7ed1979a87`. Read-only inspection found no open Issues or PRs.

The [PMX format document](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hirakuni45/glfw3_app/master/glfw3_app/docs/PMX_spec.txt) defines group references and rate multiplication and explicitly excludes grouping groups. Retain the prior planning correction: nesting was previously unresolved; this format profile does not require a recursive evaluator. The document is a mirrored format-author reference, not measured original-MMD execution.

[Core glTF](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KhronosGroup/glTF/main/specification/2.0/Specification.adoc) defines additive morph targets before skinning. Compiling weighted child deltas is an inference from that representation. [Historical official Three.js MMDLoader](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrdoob/three.js/r169/examples/jsm/loaders/MMDLoader.js) demonstrates this approach; its silent omission of other children must not be inherited. [Official r186 GLTFLoader](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrdoob/three.js/r186/examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js) loads relative POSITION targets. Acceptance must use the lockfile's Three.js 0.186.1; exact upstream tag/package byte equivalence was not established.

Current tooling includes glTF Transform 4.5.1, mmd-parser 1.1.4, Node tests, glTF Validator and Playwright 1.56.1. Existing tests cover vertex morphs and lifecycle behavior. [PR #40](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/pull/40) and saved evidence report 64 Node passes, 25 browser passes and two optional WebGPU skips. Current merged hosted browser execution remains in progress; test presence and reported local passes are distinct evidence.

This Issue covers converter, metadata/contract documentation, reusable plugins and Demo together. Bone/UV/material/flip/impulse morphs, ordered IK/append, physics, scene controls and representative fidelity remain mandatory overall work. VMD animation and VPD poses remain mandatory; this Issue does not complete the overall goal.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Document and implement the compilation/composition contract, zero defaults, target ordering, numeric limits, empty-group handling and unsupported-child policy. Preserve source names/indices and complete group references/rates through GLB and unpacked glTF. Retain compatibility with existing vertex-only metadata and VMD payloads; document/version metadata changes where necessary.
- [ ] Validate counts, references, rates and resulting FLOAT deltas. Reject malformed numeric/reference data with actionable errors. Explicitly diagnose nested/self/cyclic dependencies and unsupported child families. A group containing an unsupported child must remain wholly unsupported with its dependency details retained; never execute only its supported subset. Preserve explicit VMD unmatched/ignore reporting.
- [ ] Add deterministic, attributed synthetic group fixtures for both distinct box/wedge rigs and two distinct group-bearing VMD motions. Cover group-only and simultaneous direct/group weights, shared children, duplicate contributions, forward references, signed/zero rates, duplicate names and explicit byte-name mapping. Test malformed inputs and failure atomicity. Retain existing scenarios and assertions, adjusting target-layout expectations only where newly supported groups require it.
- [ ] Exercise API/CLI conversion, direct VMD bytes, extension-aware GLB/glTF playback and ordinary core fallback. Compare keys and the existing 1201-point grid against independently authored scalar predictions, including the 0.7 example. Retain weight error ≤1e-6 and BDEF position error ≤2e-6 m. Add focused group-before-SDEF/QDEF probes using existing advanced-skinning tolerances. Validate generated assets with the existing glTF Validator/schema tooling.
- [ ] Demonstrate manual group apply/reset, seek/play/pause, actual loop crossings, non-loop endpoints, ownership replacement, instance isolation and disposal. On both rigs, apply/reset both existing VPD poses while retaining group/direct weights, then resume VMD correctly. Serialize applied states through the existing glTF export paths and verify reload, metadata and repeat application without double deformation.
- [ ] Integrate both group-bearing motions on both rigs into the built Demo through bytes/GLB/glTF. Record independently predicted deformation, matching rendered revisions and canvases for Toon and core PBR with outlines enabled/disabled. Retain existing raster limits, held-frame/paused negative controls, lifecycle coverage, timeouts and existing regression scenarios.
- [ ] The Coordinator runs the existing setup/check sequence: `npm ci`, `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, Chromium installation if needed, `PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_CHANNEL=chromium npm run test:browser`, `npm run check:links`, and `git diff --check`. Record source/fixture provenance, measured maxima, actual pass/fail/skip results and remaining limitations. Implementation, testing, PR review and merge remain with the Coordinator; add no independent AI review stage.
- [ ] Update affected converter/plugin/Demo documentation and validation evidence. Any evidence-backed correction to an AI-authored technical requirement must retain the old assumption, corrected requirement, inspected primary source and rationale. Such corrections need neither human approval nor independent AI re-review and must not weaken acceptance to accommodate unfinished code or failing tests.

## Optional validation

Capture controlled original-MMD measurements of direct-plus-group and duplicate contributions using lawful synthetic assets, recording MMD version, inputs and outputs. Keep these separate from alternative-renderer and self-consistency evidence. Native WebGPU observations are optional where an adapter is available.

## Required post-merge verification

None required.

## Specification reconciliation

This task was authored by AI under the agreed MMD/glTF model, VMD animation and
VPD pose reproduction goal. Correct erroneous technical assumptions or acceptance
criteria when primary specifications or measured evidence establish the correction.
Update this Issue and record the original
assumption, corrected requirement, primary reference and rationale in the PR.
These technical corrections require neither human approval nor an independent AI
re-review. Preserve the agreed goal and relevant pre-merge acceptance; do not weaken
requirements merely to accommodate incomplete implementation or failing tests.
